quotes.text: # Set up a subscription with Cash App Pay
This article has multiple variants. Fetch one of the following URLs to view specific content for your use case:

old_evidence.text: This is a Setup Intents API for when api-integration is setupintents.
This is a Subscriptions API for when api-integration is subscription.
This is a Stripe-hosted page for when api-integration is checkout.

findings: The 2026-11-07 capture at the same canonical URL is only a 15-line variant index. It names Setup Intents API, Subscriptions API, and Stripe-hosted page variants with exact query URLs (new lines 9-15); it gives no API fields, authentication flow, eligibility, success state, or runtime outcome.

The matched 2026-05-13 capture is a 241-line combined guide that includes labeled setupintents, subscription, and checkout sections at the same base URL (old lines 10-14, 93-97, 168-172). Its path details remain dated historical evidence and are not contradicted merely because the November base rendering is an index.

The existing source is routed through wiki/index.md to wiki/stripe-index.md:660 and wiki/concepts/stripe-cash-app-pay.md:70. Its three-path structure agrees with the new index labels, but only the older capture provides detailed parameters, QR/redirect authentication and testing information (old lines 34-89, 117-166, 192-241).

Recommend retaining the old raw in the factual source provenance and treating the November base capture as a navigation reference to variant URLs. The listed query pages have not been read here and provide no behavioral evidence for this review.
substantive_changes: The captured base URL changed presentation from a combined three-variant guide to a three-link index (old lines 8-241; new lines 9-15). The index alone establishes no substantive change or removal of SetupIntent, Subscriptions API, or Checkout behavior.

The new index supplies exact variant query URLs only. Their existence is navigational; whether their content now differs from the May combined guide remains unresolved without separately pinned, approved captures.
historical_claims_to_preserve: Keep May 2026's SetupIntent confirm/off_session/cashapp/mandate_data/return_url example, requires_action QR or redirect step, and default_payment_method subscription creation as May evidence (old lines 34-89).

Keep May 2026's default_incomplete subscription and separate PaymentIntent confirmation example, as well as Checkout subscription-mode session and sandbox/live UX, with old-capture dating and path-specific conditions (old lines 117-166, 192-241).
Do not add the November navigation-only index to factual raw_files or replace May behavioral citations with it; if linked, identify it as an index that routes to three variants.
conflicts: Current source lines 54-55 and wiki/concepts/stripe-cash-app-pay.md lines 15-18, 52-55 imply mandate_data and return_url are required for all three paths. The May Checkout session example has neither parameter (old lines 209-227), while the direct SetupIntent and PaymentIntent confirm examples include them (old lines 43-60, 149-161). Treat sample presence/absence as path-specific example evidence, not a universal requiredness rule. The November index supplies no resolution.

Current source line 13 calls this an integration guide without a date in its prose; its frontmatter date is May 13. The November base URL now renders an index only (new lines 9-15), so a current-behavior reading of the source should be qualified as May evidence.
unresolved_questions: Current content and field requirements of the three November query variants are unknown because the approved capture provides only links, not their pages; do not infer deprecation, changed eligibility, or a new payment flow from omission.
The current index does not establish account-level Cash App Pay eligibility, authentication success, payment finality, or any completed subscription.

answers.Q1: At https://docs.stripe.com/billing/subscriptions/cash-app-pay, the November capture establishes only that the article now routes readers to Setup Intents API, Subscriptions API, and Stripe-hosted page query variants (new lines 9-15). The May capture at the same base URL combined all three sections and documented separate setup authorization, subscription-plus-PaymentIntent confirmation, and Checkout session examples (old lines 10-14, 93-97, 168-172). [[source-stripe-subscriptions-cash-app-pay]] summarizes those May details. The index itself establishes no prerequisites, account identity, authentication state, payment success, or current variant behavior beyond the available navigation labels.
answers.Q2: At https://docs.stripe.com/billing/subscriptions/cash-app-pay, the visible change is presentational routing from a combined guide to a variant index; it is not evidence that the May paths were removed or substantively changed (old lines 8-241; new lines 9-15). Keep [[source-stripe-subscriptions-cash-app-pay]] claims dated to May and retain the old raw for behavioral evidence, using the new capture only as a navigation reference. Direct API examples include mandate_data and return_url, while the old Checkout example does not show them (old lines 43-60, 149-161, 209-227), so no universal requiredness follows. Unread query variants and account/payment outcomes remain unresolved.
